question.text: Managers prefer a catch-up rate of:

answer.text: 100% (all residual profit to Manager till catch-up complete)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.9, Managers prefer a 100% catch-up rate — all residual profits flow to the Manager till catch-up is complete. The Trap: Lower catch-up rates are more investor-friendly and less preferred by Managers. Cross-Exam Context: Classic agency-cost concept. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Negotiate a partial catch-up (e.g., 50%) on behalf of investor clients.
